facultyDescription: Faculty is the backbone of every successful institution to shine, and IIT Madras knows it very well having 645 eminent professors at its faculties who are known for publishing research papers in national and international publishers like The Nature, The Science, Elsevier, etc., of whom 99.84% are Ph.D. holders and the professor-to-student ratio is 1:10, that is, every 10 students will have a professor to teach and guide.
